raw.rationale: AZD9668 is a highly selective neutrophil elastase (ELANE) inhibitor with no known broad cytotoxic activity, and ELANE dependency is largely restricted to myeloid/neutrophil-lineage cells rather than the listed solid tumour lineages; PRISM viability screens of non-myeloid adherent lines therefore show little or no lineage-selective killing at 2.5 µM. Any apparent selectivity would be nonspecific and rare, so probabilities are near the low end of the stated base rate.
